content.text: I've seen enough. This screen is full of coloured labels and red minuses, and I'm getting tired. I'm stopping here.

input.answer: According to the page, with 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the cheapest choice is a Psagot securities account (פסגות ניירות ערך) holding the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund. It says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after I put in 135,000 ₪, assuming 2% inflation a year and 7% growth a year. At my own bank (Leumi) it shows less, about 172,096 ₪, because the bank takes about 11,643 ₪ in fees against Psagot's 2,604 ₪.

stuck.why: I typed 750 and the box shows 750, but the slider under it seemed set to 800. I wasn't sure which one the sum used.
The 7% was already filled in for me. Nothing says this is a guess and not a promise, and I didn't change it.
There were lots of coloured tags and red numbers with minus signs. It made me nervous, and this is where I stopped.

structured_output.answer: According to the page, with 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the cheapest choice is a Psagot securities account (פסגות ניירות ערך) holding the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund. It says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after I put in 135,000 ₪, assuming 2% inflation a year and 7% growth a year. At my own bank (Leumi) it shows less, about 172,096 ₪, because the bank takes about 11,643 ₪ in fees against Psagot's 2,604 ₪.
